ns2:course.label: Applied Econometrics
ns2:course.description: Focus on specification, estimation, prediction and evaluation of econometric models. Covers instrumental variable estimation, simultaneous equation models, non-linear models, discrete choice models and quantile regression methods. Prerequisite: ECON 532 and ECON 535.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
